responsibility: Computes strongly connected components for directed graphs, builds the condensed SCC DAG with deduplicated successor edges, tracks the mapping from original nodes to SCC indices, and optionally propagates user-defined commutative annotations within and across SCCs.
same_name_distinction: Within the `mod.rs` group, this file is the graph-analysis module for strongly connected components and their condensed DAG; unlike `graph/dominators` it groups cyclic regions, and unlike the graph storage modules it derives a new graph view instead of storing the original graph.
